text:
marta: Putting a note here we need a low-friction experience in Console for the upcoming v1->v2 migration. Main goals: inform customers, let them sanity-check with cheap probes, and make billing explicit so there are no surprises.

owen: Agree. My proprosal: Console shows (a) compatibility indicator (green/amber/red), (b) cost delta estimate, (c) one-click "Run probe" that can do shadowing or a tiny live cohort. Keep language calm.

samir: On routing: current precedence is pin > header > default route. If a request would hit an incompatible model we return 409; if it's compatible we may route to the compatible variant. We'll surface the final routed model in the response header `X-Routed-Model`.

marta: Good. Need telemetry keys so we can build dashboards: `compat_state`, `probe_mode`, `probe_pct`, `routed_model`, `route_reason`, `billing_model_id`. Also tag probe runs with `probe_run_id`.

infra-lee: For probes, we suggest default shadowing at 100% (no user impact) + optional live at 0.1%. We'll gate live with header `X-Compat-Probe: live=true` and route those requests to a probe bucket.

owen: For the estimate, billing-service will return an "estimated monthly delta" and a confidence level. We should also include a tokenization adjustment factor when models tokenize differently.

samir: Implementation note: routing layer should emit an event that includes `billing_model_id` and `token_factor` for each routed request. Cost estimator in Console will call a billing endpoint to get the delta.

marta: UX: show a tiny sparklines of error rate and latency for the tenant baseline and the projected after switch. Add a confidence badge (low/med/high). Provide a link to run a 10k-request simulation.

infra-lee: Ops needs a safety net: automatic rollback if 5xx increases by >2.5x or absolute +0.4% for 5 minutes. Make that configurable per-tenant toggle in Console.

owen: Also show an audit timeline: who ran a probe, when, and what the outcome was. Keep audit retention 90 days.

samir: Dev detail: for SDK users we should return `X-Compatibility: partial` when behavior may be materially different so client teams can log or surface it.

billing-bot: Billing note: invoices always reflect executed model and token usage. Console estimate is just an estimate. We'll add `estimate_delta(project_id,candidate_model_id)` endpoint with `confidence` and `token_factor` fields.

marta: Research asks: ML wants a daily compact sample of mismatches (100/day) with PII scrubbed to S3 for debugging. Retain 14 days. Legal wants the scrub rules documented.

infra-lee: We'll implement scrubber: remove user ids, hash uuids, strip email addresses, truncate prompts >500 chars. Add retention lifecycle.

owen: Implementation checklist: 1) routing emits billing_model_id/token_factor; 2) probe header respected and routed to bucket; 3) telemetry fields added; 4) UI mock + copy; 5) estimator endpoint.

marta: Owners: Owen -> routing/estimator integration, Samir -> telemetry and SDK headers, Infra-Lee -> probe infra and scrubber, Billing-Bot -> estimator. I'll file the issue and link design mocks here. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: feature/compatibility-console -> staging (sha: deadbeef) :rocket:

marta: One final UX note: avoid alarming phrasing; prefer "compatible variant" over "fallback". We'll write exact copy in the PR.

owen: Will add a small "simulate now" beta that runs a quick 1k shadow run and returns a short report. Good way for teams to eyeball changes before larger probes.

samir: I'll add the telemetry schema PR and include sample queries for the Console dashboard.

marta: Thanks team, drop PR links here and tag me for review."
